entries.title: Check a project change before Firstmate applies it
entries.body: You can now change a project's name, folder and where it lives in Settings → Projects, and Firstmate can change these and its other settings. A change you asked for in exact words applies at once; otherwise a card shows what changes, and only Apply change applies it. A new address for where it lives always asks first. Your project keeps its key and history. A folder change never moves files: move the folder yourself once its tasks are finished. A project kept on this computer offers only Local merge until you approve where it lives.

picture.alt: A card titled Change site? showing the project's Care going from Default to Careful under Now and After your click, with Apply change and Not now buttons
